newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-TONKOV TIGHTENS GRIP ON GIRO LEAD.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-TONKOV TIGHTENS GRIP ON GIRO LEAD.

text.p: Defending champion Pavel Tonkov tightened his grip on the Giro d'Italia lead on Wednesday when he won the fifth stage on the 1,675-metre Terminillo mountain.

The Russian raced in just clear of French challenger Luc Leblanc with Italy's Marco Pantani third after the overnight threat of Russian Yevgeny Berzin died in the last 10 kilometres of the 215-km leg from Arezzo.

Berzin, the 1994 Giro winner, was only one second adrift of Tonkov in the overall placings before Wednesday's stage but trailed home at Terminillo five minutes 24 seconds after him. Tonkov's new threat is Leblanc who was 37 seconds behind overnight.
